answerUz: Present Simple zamoni bo‘yicha 5 ta diagnostik savolni tayyorladim. Birinchi ikki savol asosiy tushunchani tekshiradi, keyingi ikkitasi qo‘llashni, oxirgi savol esa bir nechta g‘oyalarni birlashtiradi. Javoblaringizni yuboring, keyin natijalar asosida keyingi mashg‘ulotni belgilaymiz.

questions.question: Quyidagi jumlalar qaysi biri Present Simple zamonida to‘g‘ri?
options: She go to school every day.
She goes to school every day.
She going to school every day.
She gone to school every day.

questions.question: "I ___ (like) coffee" gapini Present Simple bilan to‘ldiring.
questions.explanationUz: Birlik birinchi shaxsda verb o‘zgarmas holda "like" bo‘ladi.

questions.question: Quyidagi gaplardan qaysi biri odatiy harakatni ifodalaydi?
options: He is reading a book now.
He reads a book every night.
He will read a book tomorrow.
questions.explanationUz: Har kuni yoki har kecha kabi takrorlanuvchi harakat Present Simple bilan ifodalanadi.

questions.question: Quyidagi gapni Present Simple ga o‘zgartiring: "They are playing football on Sundays."
Agar "She always ___ (be) late for class" gapini Present Simple bilan to‘ldirsak, qaysi variant to‘g‘ri va nega?
questions.skillUz: Present Simple – doimiy holat va to‘g‘ri fe’l shakli
questions.explanationUz: "She" 3‑shaxs birlik, shuning uchun "be" fe’lining Present Simple shakli "is" bo‘ladi. "Always" so‘zi doimiy holatni ko‘rsatadi, lekin zamonga ta’sir qilmaydi.
